Comment: aml-daily (BQ1 hot path): one new day of transactions -> clean -> features -> score -> name patterns. Terraform templatefile() fills four placeholders: bucket, emr_app_id, emr_job_role_arn, athena_workgroup.

Read input.Comment: Started by the EventBridge rule (an S3 'Object Created' event) or by hand with {"dataset": "HI-Large", "date": "2022-09-12"}.

Job settings.Comment: Spark settings as in local/runs/run_final_serverless.py, plus AML_RUN_DATE: it puts every job in daily mode (this day's week so far; scores and names go to the live_* tables).

Parameters.spark.$: States.Format('--py-files s3://${bucket}/jobs/jobs.zip --conf spark.archives=s3://${bucket}/jobs/venv.tar.gz#environment --conf spark.emr-serverless.driverEnv.PYSPARK_DRIVER_PYTHON=./environment/bin/python --conf spark.emr-serverless.driverEnv.PYSPARK_PYTHON=./environment/bin/python --conf spark.executorEnv.PYSPARK_PYTHON=./environment/bin/python --conf spark.emr-serverless.driverEnv.AML_ROOT=s3://${bucket} --conf spark.executorEnv.AML_ROOT=s3://${bucket} --conf spark.emr-serverless.driverEnv.AWS_REGION=us-east-1 --conf spark.executorEnv.AWS_REGION=us-east-1 --conf spark.emr-serverless.driverEnv.AML_RUN_DATE={} --conf spark.executorEnv.AML_RUN_DATE={} --conf spark.driver.cores=4 --conf spark.driver.memory=12g --conf spark.driver.maxResultSize=2g --conf spark.executor.cores=4 --conf spark.executor.memory=10g --conf spark.executor.memoryOverhead=3g --conf spark.dynamicAllocation.maxExecutors=3 --conf spark.sql.autoBroadcastJoinThreshold=-1', $.run.date, $.run.date)
Parameters.driver.$: States.Format('--py-files s3://${bucket}/jobs/jobs.zip --conf spark.archives=s3://${bucket}/jobs/venv.tar.gz#environment --conf spark.emr-serverless.driverEnv.PYSPARK_DRIVER_PYTHON=./environment/bin/python --conf spark.emr-serverless.driverEnv.PYSPARK_PYTHON=./environment/bin/python --conf spark.executorEnv.PYSPARK_PYTHON=./environment/bin/python --conf spark.emr-serverless.driverEnv.AML_ROOT=s3://${bucket} --conf spark.executorEnv.AML_ROOT=s3://${bucket} --conf spark.emr-serverless.driverEnv.AWS_REGION=us-east-1 --conf spark.executorEnv.AWS_REGION=us-east-1 --conf spark.emr-serverless.driverEnv.AML_RUN_DATE={} --conf spark.executorEnv.AML_RUN_DATE={} --conf spark.driver.cores=8 --conf spark.driver.memory=48g --conf spark.dynamicAllocation.initialExecutors=0 --conf spark.dynamicAllocation.minExecutors=0 --conf spark.dynamicAllocation.maxExecutors=1 --conf spark.emr-serverless.driver.disk=100g', $.run.date, $.run.date)

Parameters.QueryString.$: States.Format('SELECT count(*) AS n FROM analytics.pipeline_runs WHERE pipeline = \'aml-daily\' AND dataset = \'{}\' AND date_to = DATE \'{}\' AND status IN (\'RUNNING\', \'SUCCEEDED\')', $.run.dataset, $.run.date)

States.Format('INSERT INTO analytics.pipeline_runs (run_id, pipeline, dataset, date_from, date_to, status, started_at) VALUES (\'{}\', \'aml-daily\', \'{}\', DATE \'{}\', DATE \'{}\', \'RUNNING\', current_timestamp)', $.run.run_id, $.run.dataset, $.run.date, $.run.date)

Clean.Comment: clean_transactions_spark.py: this day's week so far, from raw/transactions/set=<dataset>/date=*/

Features v2.Comment: build_features_spark.py: account-day graph features, week so far + 21 days of look-back

Payment features.Comment: build_txn_features_spark.py <dataset> features_v2: one row per payment

Features v3.Comment: build_features_v3_spark.py: 'unusual for this account' and owner features on top of v2

Score.Comment: score_final_spark.py: stage 1 on this day's payments with the frozen model in models/final/ -> analytics/live_*

Name patterns.Comment: final_group_namer.py (plain Python on the driver): stage 2 names this day's alerts, linking back to earlier days' alerts -> analytics/live_alerts_named

Parameters.QueryString.$: States.Format('UPDATE analytics.pipeline_runs SET status = \'SUCCEEDED\', finished_at = current_timestamp WHERE run_id = \'{}\'', $.run.run_id)

Log failure.Comment: aws/sql/run-log/log_failure.sql. The full cause stays in the execution history.

Parameters.QueryString.$: States.Format('UPDATE analytics.pipeline_runs SET status = \'FAILED\', finished_at = current_timestamp, error = \'{}\' WHERE run_id = \'{}\'', $.error.Error, $.run.run_id)

Run failed.Cause: A step failed after its retries; see the execution history and analytics.pipeline_runs.
